messages.subject: Stan intro in Amherst, MA
parts:
I'm doing a brief intro to Stan Thursday in Amherst, MA at the University of Massachusetts:

http://www.meetup.com/Pioneer-Valley-and-Five-College-R-Statistical-Meetup/events/225613144/

As the meetup blurb indicates I'm not going to attempt a full tour but I will try to touch on all the
pieces required to make it easier to build on models from the manual and understand what is
happening to make the inference go.
